title: Content Lead
text:
Content Lead
San Francisco
About Browserbase Browserbase is the complete platform for building and deploying AI agents that browse and interact with the web like humans. With a single API key, developers can enable agents to search and retrieve information, fill out forms, and take action across websites. Today, Browserbase powers more than 50 million browser sessions each month for over 10,000 customers, including Ramp, DeepMind, Clay, Vercel, and Notion. We're a Series B startup that's tripled our headcount in 2 years, and we're continuing to grow, fast. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, CRV, and Notable Capital, our team is building on our CEO's founding vision to power the world's best AI tools and help everyone automate the web. About Browserbase Browserbase is the complete platform to build and deploy agents that browse and interact with the web like humans. We’re on a mission to make AI work for people by operating the systems built for humans. We provide one API key for agents to search and fetch information, fill out forms, and replicate user actions. We run 50M+ sessions/month for 10,000+ customers including Ramp, Deepmind, Clay, Vercel, and Notion. We're a Series B startup that's tripled our headcount in 2 years, and are continuing to grow, fast. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, CRV, and Notable Capital, our team is building on our CEO's founding vision to power the world's best AI tools and help everyone automate the web. About the Role We're looking for a Content Lead to own our content-led-growth engine. This role would oversee all awareness activities across blogs, docs, socials, SEO, and launches to fuel our top of funnel. You'll craft the point of view that makes developers and technical buyers understand our category and product. You’re a great fit for this role if you’ve been in Product Marketing, Content Strategy, Growth Engineering, or Brand Marketing. You love telling stories, writing, and have great taste. And of course, you’ve been an engineer or can market to one. What you'll do Drive the content strategy and bar for Browserbase across organic & paid channels to hit our growth goals and measure success. Define the market we’re operating in and the thought leadership we need to own it, in partnership with our Product Marketers. Run and grow a team that spans content, product marketing, and developer experience. Review and create content that developers actually want to read and share. Work on strategic technical partnerships for where Browserbase can integrate with other tools. This includes integrations, documentation, and co-marketing. Partner with Sales, Product, and Growth making sure content performs, converts, and is useful across the funnel. Represent Browserbase in high-visibility moments like launches, executive writing, PR, and Partnerships. What we're looking for 7+ years in content or brand marketing at a developer-facing company, with execution and strategy. A track record of building content programs that moved pipeline and revenue. Fluency across Twitter, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Hacker News. Strong SEO instincts and comfort with paid content and distribution, not just organic. Excellent writing and editing, with a clear point of view on what makes writing good. Experience managing and growing a team. A real interest in the browser automation and AI agent space, and the judgment to translate that into a market narrative. You've led content at a company through a major market shift or category creation. You've written or ghostwritten for executives. Benefits Competitive salary + meaningful early-stage equity Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents 401(k) Daily catered lunches with a fully-stocked kitchen Beautiful office in downtown San Francisco All the AI tools + credits you want Regular team offsites and company events Base Compensation $215,000 — $260,000 USD Browserbase is an equal opportunity employer. As a key member of our growing talent team, you'll partner closely with hiring managers and leaders across the company to find, engage, and hire exceptional people who can make a meaningful impact as we scale. Whether your background is in technical recruiting, GTM recruiting, or a combination of both, we're looking for someone who brings curiosity, strong judgment, intentionality, and a high level of ownership to every search. title: Partnerships Lead
text:
Partnerships Lead
San Francisco
About Browserbase Browserbase is the complete platform for building and deploying AI agents that browse and interact with the web like humans. With a single API key, developers can enable agents to search and retrieve information, fill out forms, and take action across websites. Today, Browserbase powers more than 50 million browser sessions each month for over 10,000 customers, including Ramp, DeepMind, Clay, Vercel, and Notion. We're a Series B startup that's tripled our headcount in 2 years, and we're continuing to grow, fast. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, CRV, and Notable Capital, our team is building on our CEO's founding vision to power the world's best AI tools and help everyone automate the web. About the Role Browserbase is hiring our first partnerships leader to own channel and partnerships end to end. Today our ecosystem momentum is largely organic, agent frameworks that ship on Stagehand, integrations like 1Password and Cloudflare, teams that discover us through a model provider or a marketplace. Your job is to turn that pull into a repeatable, measurable revenue channel. This is a build role. You'll define the partner strategy, sign the first cohort of partners, negotiate the agreements, stand up the co-sell and marketplace motion, and instrument attribution so partner-sourced revenue shows up in the forecast alongside direct. You'll report to the Head of Sales and carry a pipeline target and revenue number. You'll own four surfaces: Technology & ecosystem partners : model providers, agent frameworks, orchestration and dev platforms, identity, and security. Integrations that make Browserbase the default browser layer in someone else's stack. Cloud marketplaces & hyperscalers : AWS, GCP, and Azure listings, private offers, committed-spend drawdown, and co-sell with field teams. Services partners : SIs, AI consultancies, and agencies building agents for customers in healthcare, fintech, legal, supply chain, and GTM. Resell, referral & OEM : referral programs, VAR/distribution where it unlocks new geographies or segments, and embedded/OEM deals where a platform runs Browserbase under the hood. Key Responsibilities Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue as a number, with a quarterly forecast commit. Our expectation is you come within 3-7% of that commit every quarter. Build the partner strategy from scratch: segment the ecosystem, pick the 10–15 partnerships that actually move revenue, and know when to say no to partnerships that don’t move the needle. Recruit, negotiate, and launch partnerships: commercial terms, rev share, referral fees, OEM and co-sell agreements: working with legal and finance on repeatable paper. Stand up and scale our cloud marketplace presence, including listings, private offers, and co-sell motions with hyperscaler field teams. Build a services partner program: enablement, certification, deal registration, and joint delivery for agent implementations. Win the internal sell. Get AEs, SEs, and TCSMs to work partner-sourced deals, and make partner routing something reps want rather than tolerate. Partner with Product and Engineering on what needs to exist for an integration to be real, APIs, docs, reference implementations, co-built features, and advocate for the roadmap items that unlock the biggest partners. Run joint GTM with Marketing: launches, co-marketing, joint content, conference presence, and developer programs around Stagehand and MCP. Instrument the function. Define attribution from first touch, build partner reporting in CRM, and report performance to leadership monthly. Bring ecosystem intelligence back inside, where the agent stack is consolidating, who's about to build versus buy, and what that means for our roadmap and positioning. You're a good fit if you... Have 7+ years in partnerships, channel, or business development, with time at a developer-infrastructure, API, or AI/ML company. Have built a partner function from zero, not inherited one, and can point to revenue you can defend as sourced or influenced. Have run cloud marketplace and co-sell motions with at least one hyperscaler, and understand private offers and committed-spend drawdown. Have negotiated real commercial agreements: rev share, referral, OEM, and reseller terms. Are technical enough to hold a credible conversation about APIs, SDKs, agent frameworks, and MCP, and to run a whiteboard session with a partner's engineering lead without a solutions engineer in the room. Understand consumption and usage-based pricing, and how partner economics work when revenue is metered rather than seat-based. Operate as a player-coach: you'll do the sourcing, the calls, and the paper yourself for the first year, then hire behind it. Thrive without structure. You'd rather define the playbook than run someone else's. Are excited to work 4 days a week in our San Francisco HQ (or are open to relocating here). Bonus Points You've worked inside the agent or LLM ecosystem, model providers, orchestration frameworks, or agent platforms. You've built an OEM or embedded motion where your product shipped inside someone else's. You've contributed to or built around open source, and understand how OSS distribution converts to commercial revenue. You've run partnerships for a company between $5M and $50M ARR and seen what breaks on the way up. title: Sales Strategy and Operations, Senior Analyst
text:
Sales Strategy and Operations, Senior Analyst
San Francisco
About Browserbase Browserbase is the complete platform for building and deploying AI agents that browse and interact with the web like humans. With a single API key, developers can enable agents to search and retrieve information, fill out forms, and take action across websites. Today, Browserbase powers more than 50 million browser sessions each month for over 10,000 customers, including Ramp, DeepMind, Clay, Vercel, and Notion. We're a Series B startup that's tripled our headcount in 2 years, and we're continuing to grow, fast. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, CRV, and Notable Capital, our team is building on our CEO's founding vision to power the world's best AI tools and help everyone automate the web. About the role This is the founding hire on the Revenue Operations team! We’re pretty excited about it. It’s also the first one focused squarely on sales strategy and analytics, so you should have a background in Sales Ops. You will report to and work in close partnership with our RevOps Lead, along with our Head of Sales, Head of Growth, Head of Finance, AEs, and TCSMs. This role is based in San Francisco where the full team is, and we are open to New York for the right candidate. At Browserbase, we sell a usage-based product through two motions: a self-serve funnel that thousands of developers enter on their own, and an enterprise sales team that turns the best of those (and fresh outbound accounts) into large, expanding deals. This role would have to understand our revenue model to help impact strategic sales decisions like segmenting, forecasting, and compensation. What you'll do Segmentation analysis: Run the closed-won and expansion analysis that tells us how we should be carving the market and strategize the best way to ensure coverage, account assignment, and quota. Quota and capacity modeling. Build the capacity models, quota scenarios, and SDR target math that Sales leadership and Finance make decisions from. Model the levers before we pull them and bring them, with an opinion, to the team. Forecast modeling and inspection: Build and maintain the forecast model, prep the weekly call, inspect the deals behind the number, and flag where it is likely wrong before anyone else notices. You are our eyes and ears and we rely on you to make sure the data is correct. Funnel and pipeline analytics: Partner with our team on filling in the funnel from self-serve signup to PQL to SQO to closed-won to expansion. Surface the conversion points worth fixing, jump in with recommendations, and help us get creative on moving the number. We’ve worked with RevOps people before who stay squarely out of the strategic decisions and work, this job isn’t it! We want you excited by the problems and to partner on solving them. Systems troubleshooting. Understand the systems generating our numbers (HubSpot, Snowflake, Stripe, product data) well enough to triage them. Market sizing and targeting. Use enrichment tooling to size segments, build target account lists, and support outbound planning. Deal desk support. Help on pricing approvals and deal structure as volume grows. Secondary to everything above, but part of the job. Requirements 3 to 5 years in sales operations, revenue operations, sales strategy, or GTM strategy and operations at a B2B SaaS or developer tools company. A consulting or finance background with at least two years in an operating seat also works. Real analytical chops. You can build a segmentation analysis, a capacity model, and a forecast, and you know which one the question calls for. SQL or equivalent, plus actual modeling, not just pivot tables. You can take a defined piece of a larger problem and run it to a real answer without needing to own the whole thing. Great collaboration with Sales. Your customers at Browserbase will be internal so that means working well with AEs and jamming on strategic reports with the Head of Sales. Hands-on with HubSpot or Salesforce. You know the objects, the reporting layer, and where the data actually comes from. You have worked on a forecast before and understand what makes one wrong. Genuine AI tooling fluency. You use Claude, Codex, or similar to write queries, prototype internal tools, and move faster. When building something yourself is the fastest path, you build it. Low ego, high ownership. We are small and the job will definitely change. Nice to haves Usage-based or consumption pricing experience. Experience supporting both self-serve and enterprise motions, and an instinct for how they should reinforce each other. Clay, Amplemarket, Outreach, or similar for enrichment, TAM building, and outbound tooling. Quota and comp plan design experience. We are not hiring a dedicated comp analyst, but knowing how plans behave is valuable. Snowflake, dbt, or a BI tool like Hex, Looker, or Tableau. Deal desk or CPQ exposure. You have been an early ops hire before and know what breaks beyond a Series B. Benefits Competitive salary + meaningful early-stage equity Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents 401(k) Daily catered lunches with a fully-stocked kitchen Beautiful office in downtown San Francisco All the AI tools + credits you want Regular team offsites and company events Base Compensation $120,000 — $160,000 USD Browserbase is an equal opportunity employer. title: Chief of Staff
text:
Chief of Staff
San Francisco
About Browserbase Browserbase is the complete platform for building and deploying AI agents that browse and interact with the web like humans. With a single API key, developers can enable agents to search and retrieve information, fill out forms, and take action across websites. Today, Browserbase powers more than 50 million browser sessions each month for over 10,000 customers, including Ramp, DeepMind, Clay, Vercel, and Notion. We're a Series B startup that's tripled our headcount in 2 years, and we're continuing to grow, fast. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, CRV, and Notable Capital, our team is building on our CEO's founding vision to power the world's best AI tools and help everyone automate the web.
